Question Choices: A submarine sits 148.6 meters below sea level and then rises 42.8 meters. What is its new depth as a signed number? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Keep the signs and align decimal places. With opposite signs, subtract magnitudes and keep the larger magnitude’s sign.
Solution: -148.6 + 42.8 = -105.8. Align decimal points; write trailing zeros when useful. Check the sign using the larger magnitude. Exact check: -148.6+42.8 = -105.8.

Question Choices: A delivery van's fuel gauge reads 7/8 of a tank at the start of a route and 1/3 of a tank at the end. What signed number represents the change? Give your answer as a fraction.
Hints: Signed change = final value − initial value. Keep the sign of the initial value inside parentheses.
Solution: 1/3 - 7/8 = 8/24 - 21/24 = -13/24 of a tank. Check: initial value + signed change = final value. A negative change means a decrease. Exact check: 1/3-7/8 = -13/24.
